support.placementStatus: Explicit cradle-height fit checked in an oblique Blender render; not recovered runtime placement
support.liquidDepthStatus: 2D liquid surface clamped below glass for layering; runtime liquid vertex modifiers not recovered

opticalCalibration.environmentEvidence: Latitude illumination fitted on two empty-pipe strips, checked on two held-out strips; an estimated environment, not the recovered runtime reflection probe.

sceneTransmission.encoding: optical-reflection RGB = linear reflected radiance * reflectionEncodingScale; A = geometric coverage. No color conversion. Premultiply once when compositing the optical map; unpremultiply before decoding its radiance.
sceneTransmission.fallback: shell/body/wall/reflection are legacy source-over approximations; do not stack them on the scene-transmission pass.

shellAppearance.evidence: Original single-surface mesh, normals, material slots and environment BRDF. Preferred composition: linear SceneColor * source GlassColor + baked environment reflection. Reflection environment estimated from reference; runtime probe and ECS GlassColor overrides are unavailable. Legacy RGBA shell is an approximation only. Serialized RefractRatio=1 and UseCustomRefractTex=0 imply no normal-dependent offset for this view.

staticWaterLayers.blend: normal source-over, body then skin then specular; frozen full-water section

endpointConnector.sourceAxis: Unity +Z; canonical image route direction is top-to-bottom
endpointConnector.placement: Place once at the entry boundary and once at the exit boundary of every continuous route; canonical whitening points inward toward image top, so rotate image down-axis toward the route-outward tangent

provenance.appearance: Visible pale glint is a screenshot-calibrated 2D treatment of the authored bright albedo inset; the enabled emissive atlas samples black over this mesh UV island in v1.5
